vatiten et-hamat`amim ve'et-haléchem asher `asátah beyad ya`aqov benah vayavo el-aviv vayómer avi vayómer hinéni mi atah beni vayómer ya`aqov el-aviv anokhi `esav bekhorékha `asíti ka'asher dibárta elay qum-na shevah ve'okhlah mitsedi ba`avur tevarakháni nafshékha

vayiqra yitschaq el-ya`aqov vayevárekh oto vayetsavéhu vayómer lo lo-tiqach ishah mibenot kená`an qum lekh padénah aram bétah vetu'el avi imékha veqach-lekha misham ishah mibenot lavan achi imékha ve'el shaday yevarekh otekha veyafrekha veyarbékha vehayíta liqhal `amim

vatiqra et-shemo yosef lemor yosef YHWH li ben acher vayehi ka'asher yaledah rachel et-yosef vayómer ya`aqov el-lavan shalechéni ve'elekhah el-meqomi ule'artsi tenah et-nashay ve'et-yeladay asher `avádti otekha bahen ve'elékhah ki atah yadá`ta et-`avodati asher `avadtíkha

vayomer-lo elohim shimkha ya`aqov lo-yiqare shimkha `od ya`aqov ki im-yisra'el yihyeh shemékha vayiqra et-shemo yisra'el vayómer lo elohim ani el shaday pereh ureveh goy uqehal goyim yihyeh miméka umelakhim mechalatsékha yetsé'u ve'et-ha'árets asher natáti le'avraham uleyitschaq lekha etenénah ulezar`akha acharékha eten et-ha'árets vayá`al me`alav elohim bamaqom asher-diber ito

hen késef asher matsánu befi amtechoténu heshivónu elékha me'érets kená`an ve'ekh nignov mibet adonékha késef o zahav asher yimatse ito me`avadékha vamet vegam-anáchnu nihyeh ladoni la`avadim vayómer gam-`atah khedivrekhem ken-hu asher yimatse ito yihyeh-li `áved ve'atem tihyu neqiyim

ki `avdekha `arav et-haná`ar me`im avi lemor im-lo avi'énu elékha vechatáti le'avi kol-hayamim ve`atah yeshev-na `avdekha táchat haná`ar `éved ladoni vehaná`ar yá`al `im-echav ki-ekh e`eleh el-avi vehaná`ar enénu iti pen er'eh vara` asher yimtsa et-avi

vayómer YHWH el-mosheh re'eh netatíkha elohim lefar`oh ve'aharon achíkha yihyeh nevi'ékha atah tedaber et kol-asher atsavéka ve'aharon achíkha yedaber el-par`oh veshilach et-bene-yisra'el me'artso va'ani aqsheh et-lev par`oh vehirbeti et-ototay ve'et-mofetay be'érets mitsráyim velo-yishma` alekhem par`oh venatati et-yadi bemitsráyim vehotseti et-tsiv'otay et-`ami vene-yisra'el me'érets mitsráyim bishfatim gedolim

vayómer YHWH el-mosheh ve'el-aharon lemor ki yedaber alekhem par`oh lemor tenu lakhem mofet ve'amarta el-aharon qach et-matekha vehashlekh lifne-far`oh yehi letanin vayavo mosheh ve'aharon el-par`oh vayá`asu khen ka'asher tsivah YHWH vayashlekh aharon et-matéhu lifne far`oh velifne `avadav vayehi letanin

ushemartem et-hadavar hazeh lechoq-lekha ulevanékha `ad-`olam vehayah ki-tavó'u el-ha'árets asher yiten YHWH lakhem ka'asher diber ushemartem et-ha`avodah hazot vehayah ki-yomeru alekhem benekhem mah ha`avodah hazot lakhem

vayis`u merefidim vayavó'u midbar sinay vayachanu bamidbar vayichan-sham yisra'el néged hahar umosheh `alah el-ha'elohim vayiqra elav YHWH min-hahar lemor koh tomar levet ya`aqov vetaged livne yisra'el atem re'item asher `asíti lemitsráyim va'esa etkhem `al-kanfe nesharim va'avi etkhem elay

vayedaber elohim et kol-hadevarim ha'éleh lemor anokhi YHWH elohékha asher hotsetíkha me'érets mitsráyim mibet `avadim lo yihyeh-lekha elohim acherim `al-panáya lo ta`aseh-lekha fésel vekhol-temunah asher bashamáyim mimá`al va'asher ba'árets mitáchat va'asher bamáyim mitáchat la'árets

vayómer YHWH el-mosheh koh tomar el-bene yisra'el atem re'item ki min-hashamáyim dibárti `imakhem lo ta`asun iti elóhe khésef velohe zahav lo ta`asu lakhem mizbach adamah ta`aseh-li vezavachta `alav et-`olotékha ve'et-shelamékha et-tsonekha ve'et-beqarékha bekhol-hamaqom asher azkir et-shemi avo elékha uverakhtíkha

ve`asíta et-haqerashim lamishkan `esrim qéresh lif'at négbah temánah ve'arba`im adne-khésef ta`aseh táchat `esrim haqáresh shene adanim tachat-haqéresh ha'echad lishte yedotav ushene adanim tachat-haqéresh ha'echad lishte yedotav uletséla` hamishkan hashenit lif'at tsafon `esrim qáresh ve'arba`im adnehem kásef shene adanim táchat haqéresh ha'echad ushene adanim táchat haqéresh ha'echad uleyarkete hamishkan yámah ta`aseh shishah qerashim

vayómer mosheh el-aharon meh-`asah lekha ha`am hazeh ki-hevéta `alav chata'ah gedolah vayómer aharon al-yíchar af adoni atah yadá`ta et-ha`am ki vera` hu vayómeru li `aseh-lánu elohim asher yelekhu lefanénu ki-zeh mosheh ha'ish asher he`elánu me'érets mitsráyim lo yadá`nu meh-háyah lo

venatatah et mizbach ha`olah lifne pétach mishkan ohel-mo`ed venatata et-hakiyor ben-óhel mo`ed uven hamizbéach venatata sham máyim vesamta et-hechatser saviv venatata et-masakh shá`ar hechatser velaqachta et-shémen hamishchah umashachta et-hamishkan ve'et-kol-asher-bo veqidashta oto ve'et-kol-kelav veháyah qódesh umashachta et-mizbach ha`olah ve'et-kol-kelav veqidashta et-hamizbéach vehayah hamizbéach qódesh qodashim

vayómer YHWH el-mosheh peqod kol-bekhor zakhar livne yisra'el miben-chódesh vamá`elah vesa et mispar shemotam velaqachta et-halviyim li ani YHWH táchat kol-bekhor bivne yisra'el ve'et behemat halviyim táchat kol-bekhor bevehemat bene yisra'el vayifqod mosheh ka'asher tsivah YHWH oto et-kol-bekhor bivne yisra'el

veyaradti vedibarti `imekha sham ve'atsalti min-harúach asher `alékha vesamti `alehem venase'u itekha bemasa ha`am velo-tisa atah levadékha ve'el-ha`am tomar hitqadeshu lemachar va'akhaltem basar ki bekhítem be'ozne YHWH lemor mi ya'akhilénu basar ki-tov lánu bemitsráyim venatan YHWH lakhem basar va'akhaltem lo yom echad tokhelun velo yomáyim velo chamishah yamim velo `asarah yamim velo `esrim yom

vayishma` mosheh vayipol `al-panav vayedaber el-qórach ve'el-kol-`adato lemor bóqer veyoda` YHWH et-asher-lo ve'et-haqadosh vehiqriv elav ve'et asher yivchar-bo yaqriv elav zot `asu qechu-lakhem machtot qórach vekhol-`adato

daber el-ha`edah lemor he`alu misaviv lemishkan-qórach datan va'aviram vayáqom mosheh vayélekh el-datan va'aviram vayelekhu acharav ziqne yisra'el vayedaber el-ha`edah lemor súru na me`al ohole ha'anashim haresha`im ha'éleh ve'al-tige`u bekhol-asher lahem pen-tisafu bekhol-chatotam

daber el-bene yisra'el veqach me'itam mateh mateh levet av me'et kol-nesi'ehem levet avotam shenem `asar matot ish et-shemo tikhtov `al-matéhu ve'et shem aharon tikhtov `al-mateh levi ki mateh echad lerosh bet avotam vehinachtam be'óhel mo`ed lifne ha`edut asher iva`ed lakhem shámah

vayis`u miqadesh vayavó'u vene-yisra'el kol-ha`edah hor hahar vayómer YHWH el-mosheh ve'el-aharon behor hahar `al-gevul erets-edom lemor ye'asef aharon el-`amav ki lo yavo el-ha'árets asher natáti livne yisra'el `al asher-meritem et-pi leme merivah qach et-aharon ve'et-el`azar beno vehá`al otam hor hahar
ve'el-bene yisra'el tedaber lemor ish ki-yamut uven en lo veha`avartem et-nachalato levito ve'im-en lo bat unetatem et-nachalato le'echav ve'im-en lo achim unetatem et-nachalato la'ache aviv

ve'im-en achim le'aviv unetatem et-nachalato lish'ero haqarov elav mimishpachto veyarash otah vehayetah livne yisra'el lechuqat mishpat ka'asher tsivah YHWH et-mosheh vayómer YHWH el-mosheh `aleh el-har ha`avarim hazeh ure'eh et-ha'árets asher natáti livne yisra'el vera'ítah otah vene'esafta el-`amékha gam-átah ka'asher ne'esaf aharon achíkha

veha`amadta oto lifne el`azar hakohen velifne kol-ha`edah vetsivitah oto le`enehem venatatah mehodekha `alav lemá`an yishme`u kol-`adat bene yisra'el velifne el`azar hakohen ya`amod veshá'al lo bemishpat ha'urim lifne YHWH `al-piv yetse'u ve`al-piv yavó'u hu vekhol-bene-yisra'el ito vekhol-ha`edah vayá`as mosheh ka'asher tsivah YHWH oto vayiqach et-yehoshúa` vaya`amidéhu lifne el`azar hakohen velifne kol-ha`edah

vayavó'u vene-gad uvene re'uven vayomeru el-mosheh ve'el-el`azar hakohen ve'el-nesi'e ha`edah lemor `atarot vedivon veya`zer venimrah vecheshbon ve'el`aleh usevam unevo uve`on ha'árets asher hikah YHWH lifne `adat yisra'el érets miqneh hi vela`avadékha miqneh vayomeru im-matsánu chen be`enékha yutan et-ha'árets hazot la`avadékha la'achuzah al-ta`avirénu et-hayarden vayómer mosheh livne-gad velivne re'uven ha'achekhem yavó'u lamilchamah ve'atem téshevu foh

venasav hagevul me`atsmon náchlah mitsráyim vehayu totse'otav hayámah ugevul yam vehayah lakhem hayam hagadol ugevul zeh-yihyeh lakhem gevul yam vezeh-yihyeh lakhem gevul tsafon min-hayam hagadol teta'u lakhem hor hahar

vanishma` vayimas levavénu velo-qámah `od rúach be'ish mipenekhem ki YHWH elohekhem hu elohim bashamáyim mimá`al ve`al-ha'árets mitáchat ve`atah hishave`u-na li baYHWH ki-`asíti `imakhem chásed va`asitem gam-atem `im-bet avi chésed unetatem li ot emet vehachayitem et-avi ve'et-imi ve'et-achay ve'et-achyotay ve'et kol-asher lahem vehitsaltem et-nafshoténu mimávet

az yiqra yehoshúa` lar'uveni velagadi velachatsi mateh menasheh vayómer alehem atem shemartem et kol-asher tsivah etkhem mosheh `éved YHWH vatishme`u veqoli lekhol asher-tsivíti etkhem lo-`azavtem et-achekhem zeh yamim rabim `ad hayom hazeh ushemartem et-mishméret mitsvat YHWH elohekhem

ve`atah hasíru et-elohe hanekhar asher beqirbekhem vehatu et-levavkhem el-YHWH elohe yisra'el vayomeru ha`am el-yehoshúa` et-YHWH elohénu na`avod uveqolo nishma` vayikhrot yehoshúa` berit la`am bayom hahu vayásem lo choq umishpat bishkhem

vatishlach vatiqra levaraq ben-avinó`am miqédesh naftali vatómer elav halo tsivah YHWH elohe-yisra'el lekh umashakhta behar tavor velaqachta `imekha `aséret alafim ish mibene naftali umibene zevulun umashakhti elékha el-náchal qishon et-sisera sar-tseva yavin ve'et-rikhbo ve'et-hamono unetatíhu beyadékha vayómer eléha baraq im-telekhi `imi vehalákheti ve'im-lo telekhi `imi lo elekh

vayómer lo YHWH shalom lekha al-tira lo tamut vayíven sham gid`on mizbéach laYHWH vayiqra-lo YHWH shalom `ad hayom hazeh `odénu be`ofrat avi ha`ezri vayehi baláylah hahu vayómer lo YHWH qach et-par-hashor asher le'avíkha ufar hasheni shéva` shanim veharasta et-mizbach habá`al asher le'avíkha ve'et-ha'asherah asher-`alav tikhrot

asher-nilcham avi `alekhem vayashlekh et-nafsho minéged vayatsel etkhem miyad midyan ve'atem qamtem `al-bet avi hayom vatahargu et-banav shiv`im ish `al-éven echat vatamlíkhu et-avimélekh ben-amato `al-ba`ale shekhem ki achikhem hu ve'im-be'emet uvetamim `asitem `im-yerubá`al ve`im-beto hayom hazeh simchu ba'avimélekh veyismach gam-hu bakhem ve'im-áyin tétse esh me'avimélekh vetokhal et-ba`ale shekhem ve'et-bet milo vetetse esh miba`ale shekhem umibet milo vetokhal et-avimélekh

vayireshu et kol-gevul ha'emori me'arnon ve`ad-hayaboq umin-hamidbar ve`ad-hayarden ve`atah YHWH elohe yisra'el horish et-ha'emori mipene `amo yisra'el ve'atah tirashénu halo et asher yorishekha kemosh elohékha oto tirash ve'et kol-asher horish YHWH elohénu mipanénu oto nirash

vayómer mal'akh YHWH el-manóach im-ta`tseréni lo-okhal belachmékha ve'im-ta`aseh `olah laYHWH ta`alénah ki lo-yada` manóach ki-mal'akh YHWH hu vayómer manóach el-mal'akh YHWH mi shemékha ki-yavo devarekha vekhibadnúkha vayómer lo mal'akh YHWH lámah zeh tish'al lishmi vehu-féliy

vatir'u ki-nachash mélekh bene-`amon ba `alekhem vatómeru li lo ki-mélekh yimlokh `alénu vaYHWH elohekhem malkekhem ve`atah hineh hamélekh asher bechartem asher she'eltem vehineh natan YHWH `alekhem mélekh im-tire'u et-YHWH va`avadtem oto ushema`tem beqolo velo tamru et-pi YHWH vihyitem gam-atem vegam-hamélekh asher malakh `alekhem achar YHWH elohekhem

vayómer david el-yehonatan mi yagid li o mah-ya`ankha avíkha qashah vayómer yehonatan el-david lekhah venetse hasadeh vayetse'u shenehem hasadeh vayómer yehonatan el-david YHWH elohe yisra'el ki-echqor et-avi ka`et machar hashelishit vehineh-tov el-david velo-az eshlach elékha vegalíti et-oznékha

ve`atah ya`as-YHWH `imakhem chésed ve'emet vegam anokhi e`eseh itekhem hatovah hazot asher `asitem hadavar hazeh ve`atah techezáqnah yedekhem vihyu livne-cháyil ki-met adonekhem sha'ul vegam-oti mashechu vet-yehudah lemélekh `alehem ve'avner ben-ner sar-tsava asher lesha'ul laqach et-ish bóshet ben-sha'ul vaya`aviréhu machanáyim

vayiláchem yo'av berabat bene `amon vayilkod et-`ir hamelukhah vayishlach yo'av mal'akhim el-david vayómer nilchámti verabah gam-lakhádti et-`ir hamáyim ve`atah esof et-yéter ha`am vachaneh `al-ha`ir velokhdah pen-elkod ani et-ha`ir veniqra shemi `aléha

vahalo `imekha sham tsadoq ve'evyatar hakohanim vehayah kol-hadavar asher tishma` mibet hamélekh tagid letsadoq ule'evyatar hakohanim hineh-sham `imam shene venehem achimá`ats letsadoq vihonatan le'evyatar ushelachtem beyadam elay kol-davar asher tishmá`u vayavo chushay re`eh david ha`ir ve'avshalom yavo yerushaláyim

vayómer avshalom el-chushay zeh chasdekha et-re`ékha lámah lo-halákhta et-re`ékha vayómer chushay el-avshalom lo ki asher bachar YHWH veha`am hazeh vekhol-ish yisra'el lo ehyeh ve'ito eshev vehashenit lemi ani e`evod halo lifne veno ka'asher `avádti lifne avíkha ken ehyeh lefanékha

ki ka'asher nishbá`ti lakh baYHWH elohe yisra'el lemor ki-shelomoh venekh yimlokh acharay vehu yeshev `al-kis'i tachtay ki ken e`eseh hayom hazeh vatiqod bat-shéva` apáyim érets vatishtáchu lamélekh vatómer yechi adoni hamélekh david le`olam vayómer hamélekh david qir'u-li letsadoq hakohen ulenatan hanavi velivnayáhu ben-yehoyada` vayavó'u lifne hamélekh

vayómer eliyáhu el-ha`am ani notárti navi laYHWH levadi unevi'e habá`al arba`-me'ot vachamishim ish veyitenu-lánu shenáyim parim veyivcharu lahem hapar ha'echad vinatechúhu veyasímu `al-ha`etsim ve'esh lo yasímu va'ani e`eseh et-hapar ha'echad venatati `al-ha`etsim ve'esh lo asim uqeratem beshem elohekhem va'ani eqra veshem-YHWH vehayah ha'elohim asher-ya`aneh va'esh hu ha'elohim vayá`an kol-ha`am vayomeru tov hadavar vayómer eliyáhu linvi'e habá`al bacharu lakhem hapar ha'echad va`asu rishonah ki atem harabim veqir'u beshem elohekhem ve'esh lo tasímu

vayisa`er lev melekh-aram `al-hadavar hazeh vayiqra el-`avadav vayómer alehem halo tagídu li mi mishelánu el-mélekh yisra'el vayómer achad me`avadav lo adoni hamélekh ki-elisha` hanavi asher beyisra'el yagid lemélekh yisra'el et-hadevarim asher tedaber bachadar mishkavékha vayómer lekhu ure'u ekhoh hu ve'eshlach ve'eqachéhu vayugad-lo lemor hineh vedotan

venatenu et-elohehem ba'esh ki lo elohim hémah ki im-ma`aseh yede-adam `ets va'éven vaye'abedum ve`atah YHWH elohénu hoshi`énu na miyado veyede`u kol-mamlekhot ha'árets ki atah YHWH elohim levadékha vayishlach yesha`yáhu ven-amots el-chizqiyáhu lemor koh-amar YHWH elohe yisra'el asher hitpalálta elay el-sancheriv melekh-ashur shamá`eti
